# grok-export-tool

> Export your own Grok Bots and regular Grok chats from grok.com. Fully local, no API key. A CLI writes a JSONL and Markdown archive. A zero-dependency stdio MCP server and an Agent Skill let assistants query the Bot archive.

## Overview

- **`grok-bot-export.py`** — local exporter. `--mode bot` (default), `--mode chat`, or `--mode all`. `--messages-only` skips Bot attachment downloads.
- **`grok-bot-mcp.py`** — stdio MCP server, standard library only: `list_bots`, `get_bot`, `search`. It reads a Bot export. It does not index a chat export and it does not open a network connection.
- **`.claude/skills/grok-export/`** — Agent Skill (`SKILL.md`) for Claude Code, OpenCode, and other agents that load that layout.
- Archive: normalized JSONL, readable Markdown, and raw JSON.

## Platforms

- macOS: Chrome Safe Storage in the Keychain. Profiles Default, Profile 1, Profile 2.
- Windows: DPAPI when `pywin32` is installed. Otherwise `--cookie`.
- Linux: best-effort. Otherwise `--cookie "sso=...; sso-rw=..."`.
- Do not put real cookie values in issues, chat, or git.

Logs are Chinese and do not print cookie values. Export directories are mode 0700 and files mode 0600.

## Quick start

```bash
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python3 grok-bot-export.py
python3 grok-bot-export.py --messages-only
python3 grok-bot-export.py --mode chat
python3 grok-bot-export.py --mode all
```
